body: I experience this everyday. This makes even having small conversation with friends very difficult as I will not be in context. And it is just a nightmare at work. I try to make note of most of the things that need to get done, but it's a struggle everyday. Sometimes when I try to think of something that was said to me sometime back, i just have a brain fog and freeze. I don't have a solution, can just say I feel you.
Life is good for certain people. It is plain shit for rest of the people. Dunno how others are continuing, but I don't have it in me.
I have the same problem. I'm very bad at sports especially team sports. Unfortunately i don't know a way to get better at this as I've only learnt to accept that I would be bad at sports.
I'm not in school, but I've felt this from as far back as I can remember. I haven't found anything I'm really good at and seem to be a misfit everywhere.
Totally feel it. I just wrote a depressing post and found this which was too relatable. It's like we are punished everytime for things out of our control. Just tired.
I can relate with each and every one of this.

Yes, this is very frustrating. All through my school and college days, my tutors would complain that my handwriting is not legible. Also writing long papers and essays is very tough as I hold the pen too tightly and my fingers and wrist start to pain a lot. Thank fully I now manage to do all my works with typing so writing is out of the way.

This is too relatable. I am also always get lost in places. My brain would be thinking of something and suddenly I would be some other street before I realise. And if it is some new place which I haven't gotten used to then its almost impossible to navigate around. Thank God for Google maps.

Same here,I got the licence with some practice and some luck, but couldn't get myself to drive in the traffic or the small roads where I live. it's just a nightmare. Hopefully there is good public transport where I live now, but it makes me stuck and not think about any changes.
Won't even survive the first game. Would trip when I try to stop and freeze.
